responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduler model for the Cortex-M7 core. It describes the core’s dual-issue execution resources and instruction reservations for integer ALU, shifts, DSP operations, multiply/divide, loads and stores, branches, and the single- and double-precision FPU pipeline, so the Arm backend can schedule RTL according to Cortex-M7 latency, issue, and resource constraints when tuning for this microarchitecture.
